en.answer:
No, it is not.

Therefore, if only Tokens are banished by <<22741>>'s effect, no damage will be inflicted to your opponent.
en.question: If a Token is banished by <<22741>>'s『banish as many cards from your opponent's field and Graveyard as possible, then inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each card banished by this effect』effect, is it counted as a『card banished by this effect?』
en.title: If a Token is banished by <<22741>>'s effect, is it counted as a『card banished by this effect?』

ja.answer:
含まれません。

したがって、除外されたのがモンスタートークンのみの場合、『その後、この効果で除外した数×５００ダメージを相手に与える』処理は行いません。
